description: The oracle's deterministic gate: nb on Mock run bare (nb's in-process oracle) and the same nb through Harbor (the simulated user over the ACP bridge) must give the same counted cores, oracle turns and checks, apart from timings and the judge's tokens. Each ending is one stage, so a try is one stage with an answer sheet, which is the only kind the simulated user can answer.

stages.about: The model asks twice; each answer scripts its next turn, and the second ends the run
The model asks something the sheet lacks
stages.prompt: MOCK:response=What is the root password? MOCK:oracle=MISS

stages.about: The model keeps asking until the answers run out

ending.about: how the conversation with the oracle ends; each ending is one stage, and a try is that stage alone

ok.note: two answers from the sheet, then the run ends

oracle-miss.note: a question the sheet does not cover

oracle-budget.note: questions until the answers run out

route.about: where nb runs, and so which oracle answers it

bare.note: nb on Mock on the host, answered by nb's in-process oracle

harbor.note: the same nb as a Harbor agent, answered by the simulated user over the ACP bridge
